newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WALLACE REPLACES CLOHESSY IN LIONS SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WALLACE REPLACES CLOHESSY IN LIONS SQUAD.

text.p: Irish prop Paul Wallace has been called up to replace compatriot Peter Clohessy in the British Lions squad who depart for South Africa this weekend.

Clohessy, capped 16 times for Ireland, has been playing for Queensland in the Super 12 tournament but suffered a recurrence of a back injury in the squad's first training session prior to departure on Tuesday.
Wallace won the first of his 12 Irish caps against Japan in the 1995 Rugby World Cup. The 25-year-old plays his club rugby alongside former Springbok captain Francois Pienaar at Saracens.
